Hello Horror Fans,

We trust you've relished numerous years of scares with our Holy Purge Game. Today, we're excited to introduce our latest horror endeavor, 'The Descent.' Drawing inspiration from the unique walking horror experiences and jump scares of Emika games. This new game promises an array of chilling and distinctive horrors. As fellow horror enthusiasts, we believe you'll find great delight in this newest addition to our collection.

THE DESCENT

Experience 'The Descent,' a first-person psychological horror walking sim, set in the late 19th century in the coal mining town of Rockwell Mine. Immerse yourself in the grueling atmosphere of a miners environment and their unsettling encounters deep within the treacherous mines. Assume the role of an investigator who returns to this hometown after journalism school to unveil its mysteries.

Rockwell Mine has been plagued by numerous accidents, disappearances, and unexplained deaths, leaving authorities baffled. Despite countless investigations, the truth remains elusive, leading to the closure of the mine.

As a player, you must navigate the perilous mine, document your investigation with a camera, solve the mysteries behind the disappearances, and overcome obstacles while evading the dangers lurking within.

Features:
Genre: Walking Simulator
Explore room-to-room, observing evolving events.
Experience the challenges faced by miners.
Uncover the untold story of the mine.
Single Player Horror Game

We're delighted to announce that our [b]Halloween Event[/b] is returning, running throughout Steam's Scream Festival. We've resurrected the [b]Halloween decorations[/b] from last year to bring back that spooky ambiance to our maps, and [b]three costumes[/b] from the previous event are making a comeback.

[h2]KEEP SHOWING US YOUR SUPPORT.
MAKE A QUICK REVIEW. THANK YOU![/h2]

We're thrilled to share an update with you just in time for Halloween. We have been diligently crafting a brand-new map in the background. This exciting addition takes you to the mysterious locale known as the Orphanage, and the best part is it's absolutely free of charge. To all of you who support us please make a review, it would mean the world to us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/977b9091c7562d18299b95b1f06539f13345c9f3.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]New Environment[/b][/h3] The upcoming map will immerse you in the haunting atmosphere of a Russian Orphanage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a837dfafee20bf082b79810b9fc3cb7302e9e88.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/4cb625a82acc87814483d176b7acf1f228a0e272.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Story[/b][/h3]
In the mysterious St. Vladimir Orphanage in Russia, a string of baffling disappearances plagues the innocent orphans. As a dedicated investigator sent to unravel the enigma, your mission is clear: to unearth the truth behind the vanishing children and to eradicate the malevolent demon responsible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/4be32619531fbb507e48d6bae61b98a6aeaddacd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/9a809d3ef1dabec90ee6f9b89063c73e6bad54ae.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Candle Interactions[/b][/h3]
In addition to your arsenal, there will be Interactive Candles. These candles can be ignited to facilitate the search for ritual items, but beware, for every candle lit heightens the presence of lurking demonic Ghost Nuns in the vicinity, and these spirits have the ability to extinguish them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/659215fa221468d6109043ad3cc26bf74fd92ea8.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Ritual Items[/b][/h3]
The map will be teeming with a multitude of ritual items, strategically placed in varying locations with each playthrough. This dynamic arrangement ensures an added layer of replayability to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/3406e47b9b25afaa2dbfe702b5ed1f9f5b330555.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Demonic Ghost Nuns[/b][/h3]
For this map, we've introduced three new formidable Demonic Ghost Nuns. First, there's "The Wandering," an elusive specter that's perpetually on the move, requiring you to maintain unwavering vigilance. Then, we have the "Realm Jumper" a cunning entity capable of swiftly transitioning between physical areas, making your expedition particularly challenging. Lastly, there's the "The Raging Nun,"
who becomes aggressive in the presence of to much light.  Each of these spirits is committed to thwarting your quest to locate the ritual items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/db7f7e1eb5571ef416ec606e0e47999011f61de4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/f2031c87265fc747e883c0de69c92d03e9704c02.jpg[/img]
HAPPY HALLOWEEN FROM THE DEV TEAM!

notes.title: NEW MAP BIBLE CAMP RELEASED!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that [b]Holy Purge Exorcist[/b] brand [b]New Map Bible Camp[/b] is [b]Now Available[/b] to play for [b]FREE![/b] Keep in mind there is [b]only two dev's working on this[/b], if you run into issues let us know. [b]We will fix issues asap.[/b] This is by far the most ambitious game play design we have made so far. Hope you like it. Do let us know how we can make it 10x more scarier!

[h2]BIBLE CAMP MAP RELEASED PLAY NOW![/h2]
Launch trailer...
[previewyoutube=QhwU10UEgeM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BIBLE CAMP - NEW MAP DETAILS[/h2]
As you may already know, the new map takes place in a remote bible camp lake cabin resort. A terrible incident occurred which left the place abandoned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a19b3af79f0f74ca4b92f89b16bcfb626be86c3.png[/img]
Players will get 2 New Priest Outfits inspired by Midnight Mass Series for FREE!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/58e2c7ce72e6dfcfe3df17ccdcf9950f09f7615c.png[/img]
Players will have [b]2 new weapons[/b] to deal with the possessed and the demons just waiting to feast on your teams souls. The first weapon [b]The Bible[/b] when summoned will temporarily exorcise the feral children who were lost and abandoned deep in the forest from the demonic spirits that possessed them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/6637dc0b0dff899647e993e048d6f4eed39a614f.jpg[/img]
The second weapon is [b]The Orthodox Cross[/b]. This is a much more powerful weapon when compared to earlier crosses used. But requires patience with the lord to regain the lords favor. Be careful and wise to used such power, it may be the difference between life and death.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/f1bee2f8c03bd4ce743f7be849e292a3a1a72b38.jpg[/img]
Once a feral child has been acquired, your team will need to take it to one of the spiritual ritual pulpits spread across the area. You will need to read sermons while the demons attempt to stop you. It will not be easy, may the lord be with you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/5e972016f29a29be3d6e0b58694c4dc1be26e608.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/0da988bb0524823f3c508b5190b6bc952bcf3845.jpg[/img]
There are many types of demons in this map, ranging from ground runners, to Jumpers, and of course the Flying one. I suggest your teams prepare for this encounter , and fight off the reaper and werewolves in the village, and then exorcist the possessed demonic daughter before embarking on such a dangerous endeavor. Good luck and may god bless you all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/c30ef8b33f6a6279602fc80bf584cade317a1fe5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/e53244a9b4eff76d88589e2fbf1b70adfcde564a.jpg[/img]

Currently we have 7 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS for Bible Camp! GO GET THEM!

All the difficulty levels are the same for bible camp. We will have an update by the weekend and it will makes the game terrifying on harder difficulty! I forbid your teams to be tempted to fight evil on these levels! Only the most experienced elite priests should try!

PLEASE SUPPORT US WITH REVIEW IF YOU WANT US TO MAKE MORE CONTENT! THANKS! HAVE FUN!

notes.title: NEW EXORCISM MAP Now Available! PLAY NOW!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Holy Purge's brand new map Exorcism is now available to play for FREE!
[b]A FRIENDLY REMINDER IF WE REACH 75 REVIEWS, WE START WORKING ON A NEW MAP![/b] 
Check out the Exorcism Trailer.
[previewyoutube=iBoe0H1CSh4;full][/previewyoutube]

Holy Purge's new map takes place in a modern day house when a woman returns from vacation abroad and gets ill. The parents try our modern doctors for help, but her mental condition continues to deteriorate. They decide to ask for the church's help. A nun is assigned to help the girl. She ends up requesting an immediate exorcism. 

You and your team will need to cast out evil spirits lurking in the house in order to reveal items required to perform the exorcism.

Use the Holy candles to locate angel messages within the house.  These messages will help you locate the evil spirits location. Prepare your equipment and hunt it down. The resulting confrontation will cause the demon to completely possessed the girls body temporarily in order to stop your progress.  

When confronted with the evil spirit, use the video camera or holy water to weaken and banish the ghosts hiding the ritual items.  FIND the items and use them to complete the exorcism and save the girls life. If you fail your entire team will fall and become possessed.

Use the Celtic Cross to defend yourself against the Demon.  Work together to make the task of finding items and succeeding much better. God Bless your efforts! Amen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/395afa22e7131bb0d58a69fc81bdc682fe879341.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/827d638df2de391d0da5add8e8ebd0f4e92bc34b.jpg[/img]

The woman will get progressively worst as more exorcism ritual items are found.  This map is very tight and it's going to be easy to get caught by the spirits and the demons, so working together is your chance.

[b]Looking to the Future[/b]

Finally, a huge thank you to our amazing community of players who have reviewed the game.  We cannot continue this effort without your support.

If you have not made a review please do so now. We would like to continue creating new maps for Holy Purge, but we need your help to get the reviews up.

If we can reach [b]75 reviews[/b], we will [b]start working on a brand new map[/b]. [Already Planned]
Let's get the word out about this popular exorcist theme brought to you as a coop horror experience.

[b]Thanks to everyone who has made a review and supported our work.[/b]

Closed Beta SIGN UP for interested players can request access beginning today.

What languages is the Closed Beta available in?
The Open Beta test will be available in English only.

[b]Can I talk / post / create content about / or stream the Closed Beta?
No, during the closed Beta test you are not allowed to share, record, or broadcast Beta content or gameplay.[/b]

What is the reward for testing the game?
Anyone who is chosen for the beta must complete both our surveys for bugs and opinions and will receive the main game for free.

How do I know if I have been selected for the beta?
We will notify chosen people by email. 

Step 1: You will need to sign up here
[url=https://airtable.com/shrvqnIhvyGESb7oW]https://airtable.com/shrvqnIhvyGESb7oW[/url]

Step 2: Wait till we email you with details on how the beta works and how to gain access.

Step 3: Play the game.

Step 4: Fill out 2 forms so we can fix bugs and get your opinions on the game.

Thanks to all who apply.  We will choose 100 users to playtest the game.
